events.did: 推开第五扇门，门开后冲下主题乐园屋后门的破旧台阶逃出去
events.quote_anchor: Nearly crumpled in relief when it swung open onto cold morning air and a set of rickety steps at the back of the ride.

events.did: 没有走最近的小路，而是横穿乐园，在游乐设施与摊位之间穿行奔跑
events.quote_anchor: She scrambled down, hit the ground, and took off, not down the nearest path, but across it, weaving between rides and stalls as light spread across the sky.

events.did: 横穿旋转木马，钻进彩绘木马之间
events.quote_anchor: Her shoes pounded on the pavement as she cut across a carousel, ducked between the painted wooden horses.

events.did: 远远看见一个被黑衣特工包围的瘦削身影，认出那是 Victor
events.quote_anchor: This far away, he was little more than an outline, a lean shadow surrounded by agents in black gear.
Sydney took off at a dead sprint, running toward him the way she had eight years ago, when she was scared

events.did: 正要呼喊 Victor 的名字时，后背被什么东西猛撞
events.quote_anchor: She was about to call his name when something slammed into her back.

events.did: 从背后撞倒 Sydney，把她压在自己身上并喊出「Caught you」
events.quote_anchor: “Caught you,” growled Eli, crushing her back against him.

events.did: 试图撑起身体，但天地倾斜、视线模糊，意识消失
events.quote_anchor: She tried to get back up, but the world tipped, her vision blurring.

relations.did: 与 Victor 之间有她当年把他带回来时系下的那根「绳索」，此刻再次被拉紧
relations.quote_anchor: That cord she’d made, the day she brought him back, drawn taut again.

relations.did: 与 Sydney 的对抗关系：戴手套的手捂住她的嘴切断喊声，一条胳膊架住她的肩把她拖离地面
relations.quote_anchor: a gloved hand vised around her mouth, cutting off her scream. An arm wrapped around her shoulders, hauling her off the ground.

relations.did: 与 EON 黑衣特工的关系：被他们包围着出现在 Sydney 的视野里
relations.quote_anchor: She couldn’t see his face, but his white-blond hair burned like a flame in the dark beneath a ride.

relations.did: 与 Victor 的关系：认定他这一次是为她回来的
relations.quote_anchor: all that mattered was that he’d come back. For her.

numbers.did: four（试过的门共四扇）、three（其中三扇通回别的走廊）、the fourth（第四扇什么也不通）
numbers.quote_anchor: Of the four she’d tried, three had led back onto other halls, while the fourth had led nowhere.
Now she sent up a desperate prayer and threw her weight against a fifth.

numbers.who: Sydney 与 Victor 的旧事
numbers.quote_anchor: the way she had eight years ago, when she was scared, and he was safe, but the pull was even stronger now
